explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/159: there is c > 0 with R(C₄, K_n) ≪ n^{2-c}, encoded with explicit constants for all n ≥ 1, which is equivalent to the asymptotic form. graphRamsey is the standard two-colour graph Ramsey number. Erdős offered the prize for a 'proof or disproof', and stating the conjecture affirmatively as open is appropriate.
